notes.title: ver2.5.0 Update Contents
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to announce the contents of the ver2.5.0 update.[/p][p]ver2.5.0 primarily adds new treasure chests and Elite Reward Cards.[/p][p]We appreciate your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Implementation[/h2][h3]New Treasure Chests and Elite Reward Cards Implemented[/h3][p]A total of 11 new Artifact Cards have been added.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/0b756551bb37eb444ebe12f436dfc745b8df8134.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/591acac3321e1dc3033acc44dc27dd5b0d722470.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/ca4225a3c6222a02a2a4016d244941c4e3211d28.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Specification Change[/h2][p][/p][h3]Card Selection Speedup[/h3][p]For mouse: Holding down the right mouse button while hovering over cards allows for faster card selection, but we've prevented it from responding when the button is released.[/p][p]For controller: Holding down the confirmation button while inputting left or right allows for faster card selection, but we've added a brief pause when reaching the edge to make selecting all cards easier.[/p][p][/p][h3]The second floor of the dungeon[/h3][p]When moving to the second floor of the dungeon, there was an issue where the destination might not contain any enemy tiles.[/p][p]As this created a barrier to progression, we ensured that at least one enemy tile always appears on the second floor.[/p][p][/p][h3]Implemented the “Curse Card” category[/h3][p]Enemy-generated interference cards were previously treated as active cards, but we've decided to classify them separately as curse cards. Curse cards can be identified by their card frame color.[/p][p]Since they are no longer active cards, they are not generated by Overwrite and are no longer counted by Doppelganger.[/p][p][/p][h3]To be able to return from the map destination selection screen[/h3][p]Descending the stairs from the dungeon previously took you to the destination selection screen, but you couldn't return to the dungeon from there.[/p][p]Due to a specification change, you can now press the back button on the destination selection screen to return to the dungeon and claim any unreceived rewards.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ability Change for "Wings of the Whirlwind"[/h3][p]The trigger ability required confirmation and was cumbersome, so I remade it as an activate ability with similar functionality. The changes are as follows:[/p][p]\[Activate] Once per turn, during your turn when you activate a card with an original MP cost of 5 or more, you may activate this ability. You move one space forward.[/p][p][/p][h3]HP recovery at story cell[/h3][p]Since HP recovery events occurring when stamina is already sufficient serve no purpose, we've changed the specification so that recovery events now occur only when HP is 80% or lower.[/p][p][/p][h3]Card Processing Speed Improvement[/h3][p]We have revised the card activation animation to reduce the time it takes to display.[/p][p][/p][h3]Partially revised button UI[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3]The illustration on the Smirna movement card has been revised to match the intended image.[/h3][p]The illustration on the Smirna movement card has been changed. We may continue to modify illustrations that do not align with the intended image.[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][h3]Screen Scrolling[/h3][p]We have fixed a bug where scrolling the dungeon screen with the mouse during combat could cause the screen to become stuck if scrolled too far.[/p][p][/p][h3]Enemy Card Text Corrections[/h3][p]Corrected the text for Sortraps and Memory Leak.[/p][p][/p][h3]Intervention of Law Text Correction[/h3][p]Corrected two consecutive periods.[/p]

notes.title: ver2.4.0 Update Contents
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to announce the contents of the ver2.4.0 update.  In this update, we have added default cards and fixed bugs.  We look forward to your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Implementation[/h2][h3]New Card Implementation[/h3][p]We have added two cards for each character. With this update, we have completed the task of adding four cards to each character's default card pool, as mentioned in the previous update milestone.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/eaef74aac45fa08036b68174b943af8f0a61385f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Card Selection Speed Improvement [/h3][p]This feature addresses the issue of cumbersome processing when selecting multiple cards at once to choose their cost or target.[/p][p]Selection can be performed using the following methods:  Mouse: Right-click while hovering over the card selection.[/p][p]Controller: Hold down the Select button while inputting left or right.[/p][p][/p][h2]Spec Changes[/h2][h3]"Spirit Form" Spec Change[/h3][p]"Spirit Form" ability reduces all damage to 1, but we have prevented 0 damage from increasing to 1 damage.[/p][p][/p][h3]Mass Defect Specification Change[/h3][p]Mass Defect now requires payment of both MP cost and non-MP cost simultaneously. While this change has minimal impact, it was necessary to address an issue where paying the Mass Defect cost failed when sending a Super Conductor to the graveyard using Mass Defect's cost.[/p][p][/p][h3]Card Reward Visual Changes[/h3][p]We added particles to the appearance of card rewards displayed in the dungeon to make them more noticeable.[/p][p][/p][h3]“Myasma” Specification Change[/h3][p]We changed the trigger ability activation condition of “Myasma” to when a card is played from the hand.[/p][h3][/h3][h3]Dungeon Camera Position Change Method[/h3][p]We synchronized the scroll amount with the mouse position.  When you click, the camera no longer immediately returns to the center, but double-clicking the background outside of card processing will return it to the center.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]We have fixed an issue where card rewards could not be obtained when their position overlapped with the position of stairs in the dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed a bug where “Arc Tempest” was being discarded.[/p][/*][*][p]We have fixed a bug where “Metamorphosis” was being treated as an enemy-only card.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]<Translated with DeepL>[/p]

Also added pending.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Limiter Removal[/b][/p][p]Fixed to reinforcement +2=>+3.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Inferno Rod[/b][/p][p]Reworked to the following ability.[/p][p]Activate every time you play a card 3 times on your turn. You gain Reinforcement +1."[/p][p][/p][p][b]Solid State.[/b][/p][p]“I can only activate up to 10 cards on my turn.” => “I get -2 to my hand limit.” Reworked to[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thunder Smash.[/b][/p][p]Fixed to cost 3=>2.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Interrupt[/b][/p][p]Fixed to 3=>2 cost. Also fixed to 7=>10 damage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Railgun[/b][/p][p]Attack range has been corrected to 3=>4.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Storm of Ballet[/b][/p][p]Kicker cost has been corrected to 2=>1.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Crystal[/b][/p][p]Gains +1 blessing“ => ”Gains Barrier 3 and +1 blessing".[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hammer of Thunder[/b][/p][p]Fixed “get +3 reinforcement” => “get +4 reinforcement”.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cabrera Stone[/b][/p][p]Fixed so that it only activates when a buff is gained.[/p][p]Reason: Unintended behavior when enchantment was reduced by cost or when enchantment value was set to 0.[/p][p][/p][h3]Nerf[/h3][p][b]Mana Absoption.[/b][/p][p]“\[Trigger] Make your counter card's MP cost -2.” to "\[Trigger] Each time you play a counter card. You regain 1 MP." to "\[Trigger] Every time you play a counter card, you restore 1 MP.[/p][p]Reason: Cost reduction is not a feature of Smyrna. Preventing it from making it easier to play counter cards at 0 cost in a row. allow though it is possible to increase MP infinitely since it restores MP.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Abnormal Voltage.[/b][/p][p]Modified to cost 1=>2.[/p][p]Reason: Because it was too light, not corruptible, and too useful to produce damage.[/p][p][/p][p]<Translated from Deepl>[/p]

notes.content: [p]We are pleased to announce the contents of ver 2.3.0 update.[/p][p]This update implements a new card expansion set![/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.[/p][p][/p][h2]Newly implemented[/h2][p]We have implemented a new card expansion set 4 for Lydia and Smyrna respectively.[/p][p]It focuses on the newly implemented “Wound” and “Charge” enchantments.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/c972600f891829fdd960843ad92ac3bab5cedadc.png"][/img][/p][p]It focuses on the newly implemented “Wound” and “Charge” enchantments.[/p][p][/p][h3]Wounds (Debuff)[/h3][p]'Damage taken is +X. At the end of your turn, Wounds value is reduced to 0."[/p][h3]Electrification (Buff)[/h3][p]For each change in Charge value, deals damage equal to the Charge value to the nearest enemy in two surrounding squares."[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/1331fce4df0e8647dc5327eaff60dfb2470a9ca7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In addition, 2 new cards, Lydia and 2 new cards, Smyrna, were added to the default card pool.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/809c1351c7889aea26c6e231a45a463231c4c296.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Specification changes[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted the UI so that the maximum number of permanent cards that can be placed on the field does not appear to be three.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a function to display the next action in text when the cursor is moved over an enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]The damage reflection of “Absolute Zero” has been changed from once to twice even if two cards are activated at the same time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented scrolling with the mouse wheel when viewing a card in possession while a card reward was being offered.[/p][/*][*][p]The card text of “Future Vision” was incorrect, and the text has been corrected to “send 2 cards from your hand to the graveyard”.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver2.2.1 Update Contents
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the contents of ver2.2.1 update.
The ver2.2.1 update mainly fixes bugs.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

[h2]Specification changes[/h2]

[h3]Fixed Achievements for Score Acquisition[/h3]
There was a problem with the achievement of obtaining a score of 2000, which did not take into account the score obtained depending on the difficulty level.
This has been corrected so that the achievement can be achieved by obtaining 1500 for Normal and 1800 for Hard.

[h3]Fixed the ability of Holy Light[/h3]
Fixed that cards costing 0 and X are no longer eligible for the Holy Light when the cost is set to 1.

[h3]Defiance spec changes[/h3]
When adding a card with Defiance, it now does not add its own card.
No modifications have been made to the card text.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[h3]Fixed a bug in which achievements were reflected incorrectly[/h3]
Total amount of HP recovered by card abilities
Total amount of HP recovered by events
Total amount of MP gained
Total amount of enchantments gained
There was a glitch that prevented the achievements from being unlocked because these were recording the maximum values as the achievements instead of the total.
We apologize for the confusion.

[h3]Card direction selection bug[/h3]
Fixed a bug that caused the direction to be rewritten to the direction of the card being activated when a card was placed in standby mode by the delayed play function during card processing, such as Continuous Break.

[h3]Bug in the order selection of trigger abilities[/h3]
Fixed a bug that caused an inability to progress when the order selection of trigger abilities occurred at the start of a battle under certain circumstances.

[h3]Bug where the BGM did not change on the Achievements screen[/h3]
Fixed a bug where the BGM would not change when navigating directly from the title to the Achievements screen.

[h3]Damage of generated “piercing shots” was incorrect[/h3]
When a peering shot was generated, the number of times the peering shot was sent to the graveyard from the start of the battle was not calculated correctly, resulting in an incorrect amount of damage.
This has been corrected so that the count is now reflected correctly when generated.

[h3]Controller not playing next card immediately[/h3]
Fixed a problem with controllers where pressing the decision key after playing a card would not immediately put the next card in standby for play.

[h3]Drag-and-drop issue[/h3]
Fixed a problem in which dragging and dropping a card with the mouse and clicking immediately after releasing it would cause another card to be dragged.

[h3]Scrolling problem on the library screen[/h3]
Fixed a problem in the library screen where scrolling on a filter item would cause the card to scroll with it.


<Translated with DeepL>

notes.title: ver2.2.0 Update Contents
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the contents of ver2.2.0 update.
The ver2.2.0 update mainly implements Steam Achievements and adds new features.
We look forward to your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

[h2]Additional Features[/h2]

[h3]Completed implementation of Steam Achievements[/h3]
Added the ability to unlock Steam Achievements and created images for achievements.
If you have already cleared an achievement locally, the achievement will be automatically unlocked when you start the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/88f096dc8f244b06edb13735f095f693e8bedb79.png[/img]

[h3]Delayed card play[/h3]
Until now, it was not possible to play cards while the ability was being processed, but starting with this update, cards will be played automatically after the process is complete if the play operation is performed during processing.

[h3]Automatic end-of-turn function[/h3]
Added the ability to automatically end the turn if there are no cards available to play next when card processing is finished.
This is applied when the checkbox in the config is turned on.

[h3]Enchantment hyperlinks[/h3]
Hovering over an enchantment description in card text will now bring up the enchantment description.

[h3]Keyword hyperlinks[/h3]
Hovering the cursor over a keyword description in card text now brings up a description of the keyword.

[h3]Display loading screen[/h3]
The method of obtaining resources for dungeon artifacts has been slightly changed.
The black screen time immediately after starting the game has been shortened, but including the loading screen display time, it is not that different from before...

[h3]Make it possible to get the card rewards again when the game is cleared[/h3]
After clearing, the reward card is now dropped, and even if you cancel getting the card, you can go to the reward screen again by navigating to the card on the map.


[h2]Specification changes[/h2]

[h3]New cards have been added to the initial deck. [/h3]
[b]Lydia[/b]
"Shadow Fang"
1 cost
Deals 4 damage to 2 squares in front of you. Gains +3 enhancement until end of turn.

[b]Smyrna[/b]
"Energy Bolt"
1 cost
[cost]Send 1 card from your hand to the graveyard. Deal 4 damage to the front 3 squares. Gain +1 rage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/367cf3879c0fa13b35a64e06f94f54d02e1a2f32.png[/img]

[h3]Adjustment of some abilities like “make the cost 1”[/h3]
Some “make cost 1” like abilities have been modified to exclude 0-cost and X-cost cards.
This is to counteract the problem of 0-cost cards conversely increasing the cost and X-cost cards only being able to select X=0.

[h3]Improved operation when directionally selecting copied cards[/h3]
The direction could not be specified without moving the mouse a little.

[h3]Added pending to phantom blade[/h3]
A pending ability has been added to the phantom blade. The reason for this is that playing empty to prevent the phantom blade from being added to the deck is sterile, so it has been modified so that the pending prevents it from entering the deck.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the initial bonus on the first floor would incorrectly increase only the HP if the player chose to delete a card and then returned.
[*] Fixed a bug where the controller could not see the cards in your possession while selecting cards in the store square.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused thorns to continuously inflict damage when you and your enemy had thorns.
[*] Fixed a discarding ability description shake and other notational distortions.
[*] Fixed a bug that required direction selection for “Wave” cards.
[/list]

<Translated with DeepL>

notes.title: ver2.1.8 Update Contents
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the contents of ver2.1.8 update.
In ver2.1.8, we have implemented some achievements and adjusted enemy card abilities.
We look forward to your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.


[h2]Additional Features[/h2] 
We have implemented an achievement feature that works locally.
In the future, we plan to make achievements Steam compatible so that they can be unlocked.
Achievements earned in ver2.1.8 will also be reflected in Steam achievements.
However, this feature will only work when Steam functionality is available. Please note that this feature is only available when the Steam function is available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/e2411cd9050adfbd99bae64ba8995593e786b642.png[/img] 

[h2]Bug fix[/h2] 

[h3]Fixed a bug that allowed extra card acquisition[/h3] 
at one level Fixed a bug that allowed extra cards to be acquired if the player continued immediately after selecting the bonus to select two cards.

[h3]Magic Stones Earned in Scores[/h3] 
Since the score was being reflected as the increased value of magic stones possessed at the end of the game rather than as magic stones earned, the amount consumed was ignored and only the increased value was accounted for as magic stones earned.

[h3]Bug where process was not terminated[/h3] 
Fixed a bug where terminating the Dungeon Artifact game did not completely terminate the game and the process remained in the task manager.
This was a bug in Unity (game development software) and has been resolved through an update.

[h2]Specification change[/h2] 

[h3]Steam authentication[/h3] 
You can now only open dungeon artifacts via Steam. Please be aware of this.

[h3]Weakened “Void”[/h3] 
We have weakened the ‘Void’ card from the elite boss “Leviathan” in levels 21-30.
It used to take damage at the time it was drawn, but we modified the timing of taking damage to the end of the turn.
The reason is that Void's characteristic of being hard to erase from the deck is strong enough, and the way to deal with its ability to take damage at the time of draw is very limited.

[h3]Diviner deck adjustments[/h3] 
We have made major adjustments to the Diviner deck.
very hard is often penalized for playing cards, so we adopted an idea that would reverse that.
Artifacts now have the following card text, which gives the player an advantage for each damage dealt.
[list] 
[*] You get -1 reinforce and +1 wounded for each damage you take. [trigger] Activate if the value of Reinforcement is 5 or less at the end of your turn. You gain Reinforcement +12.
[/list] 

[h3]Weakened “Reactive Armor”[/h3] 
We have weakened the Reactive Armor of the 20th level boss “Ruler”. This has the following objectives
Create an opening to play Reactive Armor again 
Prevent a situation where there are two Reactive Armors on the enemy's field 

[h3]“Magma Breath” weakened[/h3] 
We weakened the “Magma Breath” of the 10-level boss “Phoenix”.
Modified to +6 combustion from +8 combustion.

[h3]“Tursos” demerit mitigation[/h3] 
Modified “Tursos” play limit from 5 to 10.

<Translated with DeepL>

notes.title: ver2.1.7 Update Contents
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the contents of Dungeon Artifact Ver. 2.1.7 update.
The changes in ver. 2.1.7 include bug fixes and specification changes.
Please wait a little longer for Steam Achievements, as they will be implemented in ver. 2.2.0.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

[h2]Specification Changes[/h2]
[h3]Changed the initial bonus content on the first floor.[/h3]
Random boss drop artifacts are now available in the Rare Card Acquisition section, and there are now three options to choose from. The rewards for the other choices will be enhanced accordingly.
The modified contents are as follows
[list]
[*] Gain 300 magic stones, max HP +10
[*] Remove 1 card from the deck, max HP+20
[*] Acquire 2 random card rewards (Rewards at the end of 3-choice battles x 2)
[*] Acquire a rare card (artifact reward from a boss drop of 3 choices)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/c9b854afc6c008a555951b85154cf0ed26454c64.png[/img]

[h3]Change in "magnetic field" ability[/h3]
"Paralysis” has been weakened so that its demerit will be the same as before the weakening.
The maximum value of my MP is +2. I get Paralysis+1 at the beginning of battle and at the end of my turn.” The text has been modified to.

[h3]Enhanced "Magic Scroll"[/h3]
Reflecting feedback on the cost payment and behavior of "Magic Scroll", the text has been revised as follows.
“[Cost] Send two cards from your hand to the graveyard. : You can activate a permanent card from your hand or graveyard without paying the MP cost.”

[h3]Changed the specification of "thorns"[/h3]
The thorns have been weakened slightly and changed so that if they take more than 1 damage, the reflection is triggered.
Thus, there will be no more reflection damage when blocked by a barrier or when 0 damage occurs.

[h3]Change in behavior of “Sea of Dirac"[/h3]
There was a problem with copying a "Sea of Dirac" in a "Multi Trigger" that caused an infinite loop and the operation did not return.
The text has been modified as follows, so that copying does not pay the cost, so the cost cannot be referenced and the operation automatically stands down.
“[Permanent][Trigger] Activate at the end of your turn. [Cost] Exclude a card in your hand at random. :Copy each card excluded by this card.”


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the mouse position to take precedence when trying to select the direction of a copied card with the controller.
[*] Fixed a bug where “Wings of the Gale” would trigger its trigger ability against enemy 5-cost cards.
[*] Fixed a bug where some cards copied by robbery could not be direction-selected.
[*] Fixed a bug where copying Absolute Zero would leave the ever-present ability of damage reflection.
[*] Fixed a bug where opening the deck screen during auto-movement could cause progress to become impossible.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse would hit the card on the SD character when the card was activated.
[/list]

[h3]Card text fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added “other than artifact cards” description in "Noise Canceller" text modification.
[*] Added “generate” keyword to the "Lightning Bullet" and "Plasma Bullet" text.
[*] Added MP cost description to the Activate ability of "Scapegoat" and "Catastrophe".
[/list]

<Translated by deepl>

notes.title: Upcoming updates (fixed)
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting “Dungeon Artifacts.”
https://steamcommunity.com/games/2144220/announcements/detail/527581830427182966
We posted a schedule of future updates here, but it is out of sync with the planned version, so we are correcting it and changing our version number management policy. We have updated the milestone information accordingly in this post.

[h1]Milestones[/h1]
First, we will list additional features, including those that have been completed. The order of implementation is determined based on priority and man-hours. For example, if the priority is low but the man-hours are small or there are requests, we will start first.
We plan to implement the items listed above first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/3cfd72136a1f5c8991988a1e82c3adb0df05bb5e.png[/img]

[h1]Add difficulty level very hard. (already supported in 2.1.0)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Extra Large
Priority: Large[/h2]
Due to the demand for increased game volume and further difficulty, this was a high priority task from the time of release.
It took about 7 months and has been addressed in 2.1.0.

[h1]Cheaper store cards. (already supported in 2.1.3)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours:Minimal
Priority: medium[/h2]
There are often situations where you go to the store and end up picking 0-1 cards, and after reviewing the situation, we decided that the pricing is too high.
Overall, we have changed the consumption of magic stones to be cheaper, especially for non-artifact cards, making it easier to pick up multiple cards.
No changes have been made to card removal, as

[h1]Make it possible to check the next boss to challenge. (already supported in 2.1.3)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: small
Priority: Medium[/h2]
With the implementation of Very Hard, it has become important to countermeasure the bosses. However, there was a problem that it was difficult to take countermeasures because the next boss was not known.
Therefore, we made it possible to know the next boss on the map screen.

[h1]Add the ability to reroll. (already supported in 2.1.4)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours:  small
Priority: Medium[/h2]
Dungeon Artifact has a problem that the number of levels before challenging bosses and elites is small, so it is necessary to challenge bosses without earning the number of card picks, which increases the difficulty in the early stages of the game.
Therefore, we will add a reroll function.
Re-rolling consumes magic stones, which can be rerolled for free at first, but the amount of rerolling will gradually increase.

[h1]Implement a boss for 32 levels. (already supported in 2.1.5)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Medium
Priority: Large[/h2]
Since the bosses on the 32nd level are random, there is a problem that the level of difficulty varies greatly depending on the boss selected, or that they are unreasonable.
Therefore, we will implement a dedicated boss for the 32nd level.
We plan to make it the same multiple bosses as before.

[h1]Implement Steam achievements. (to be supported in 2.2.0)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Medium
Priority: large[/h2]
The content may be minimal, but we intend to create a base and add to it with updates.

[h1]Implement additional extra cards. (to be supported in 2.3.0)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Large
Priority: Large[/h2]
This is a task that is high priority but has been put on the back burner because it will affect future balancing.
Lydia: We plan to implement cards that spotlight exclusion, such as triggers triggered by exclusion.
Smyrna: We plan to implement new enchantments and make them the main tactic.

[h1]More meta cards and front-loaded (strong early) cards. (to be supported in 2.4.0)[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Medium
Priority: major[/h2]
With the implementation of difficulty level Very Hard, firepower in the early stages and cards for bosses have become even more important.
Therefore, we would like to add cards to the default card pool.
We will add about 4 cards for each character.
The default card pool will grow a bit, but we plan to offset this with the reroll feature.

[h1]Weaken some of Smyrna's combo parts because Smyrna's combo performance is too high.[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Medium
Priority: Medium[/h2]
"Failnaught" and "Mana Absolution" will be nerfed a bit.
We will also strengthen cards that have not had much of a role.

[h1]Enhanced treasure and elite rewards.[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Large
Priority: large[/h2]
There is a problem that some of the cards in the treasure and elite rewards are not that useful and that the picks tend to be fixed because there are still few variations.
Therefore, it is desirable to increase the number of new cards and strengthen existing cards.
In particular, we would like to increase the variety of artifacts, and we would like to increase the number of abilities that affect things other than battles.

[h1]Enhanced diversity of story rewards.[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: Large
Priority: small[/h2]
Details to be determined.
The rewards for finishing a story are mediocre, so we would like to make the system such that upsides occur.
For example, implement an artifact that is limited to story rewards.
Also, there is no point in recovering when you are at maximum health, so we would like to make it a selective system.

[h1]Initial artifact can be changed.[/h1]
[h2]Man-hours: medium
Priority: low[/h2]
You can select an initial artifact that fits your play style from several candidates.
There is also a purpose to make it possible to release functions with experience and to create a way to use experience.

[h2]Estimated man-hours[/h2]
[list]
[*] minimum: completed in hours
[*] Small: to be completed in days
[*] Medium: to be completed in weeks
[*] Large: to be completed in months
[*] Extra-large: about six months
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Story volume increased Another person in charge is working on it.
[*] English translation being handled by another staff member
[/list]

[h1]Future product versions.[/h1]
At the time of distribution, we were planning to release the production version in six months to a year.
As improvements have been brought to light, it has become clear that we will need about a year and a half to two years. We apologize to those who are waiting for the commercial version, but it will take time to add features.

For the production version (ver 3.x.x), we would like to update it with the following three points.
[list]
[*] Implement additional features up to at least “implement additional extra cards”.
[*] Complete English language support
[*] Increase the volume of the storyline.
[/list]

notes.title: Upcoming updates
notes.content:
We apologize for the delay, but we wish you a Happy New Year.
We sincerely appreciate your support of “Dungeon Artifacts.” We are pleased to share here the milestones for the release of the commercial version. We have been working on major tasks such as adding difficulty levels, but we have not shared enough information with you because we have been basically working on the project by hand. We apologize for that.
We would like to continue to include updates once a month or so, as we have in the past. We hope you will look forward to receiving information on new content and features.

[h1]Milestones[/h1]
First, additional features, including those that have been completed, are listed below. The order of implementation is determined based on priority and man-hours. For example, if the priority is low but the man-hours are small or there are requests, we will start first.
We plan to implement the items listed above first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/201592e3e8203286ac7f46423e06a99d529c3eab.png[/img]

[h2]Add difficulty level belly hard (already supported in 2.1.0)[/h2]
[h3]Man-hour: Extra Large
Priority: Large[/h3]
Due to the demand for increased game volume and further difficulty, this was a high priority task from the time of release.
It took about 7 months and has been addressed in 2.1.0.

[h2]Cheaper store cards (already supported in 2.1.3)[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours:Minimal
Priority: medium[/h3]
There are often situations where you go to the store and end up picking 0-1 cards, and after reviewing the situation, we decided that the pricing is too high.
Overall, we have changed the consumption of magic stones to be cheaper, especially for non-artifact cards, making it easier to pick up multiple cards.
No changes have been made to card removal, as 

[h2]Make it possible to check the next boss to challenge (already supported in 2.1.3)[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: small
Priority: Medium[/h3]
With the implementation of Very Hard, it has become important to countermeasure the bosses. However, there was a problem that it was difficult to take countermeasures because the next boss was not known.
Therefore, we made it possible to know the next boss on the map screen.

[h2]リAdd the ability to reroll (to be supported in 2.1.4)[/h2]
[h3]Time required: small
Priority: Medium[/h3]
Dungeon Artifact has a problem that the number of levels before challenging bosses and elites is small, so it is necessary to challenge bosses without earning the number of card picks, which increases the difficulty in the early stages of the game.
Therefore, we will add a reroll function.
Re-rolling consumes magic stones, which can be rerolled for free at first, but the amount of rerolling will gradually increase.

[h2]Implement a boss for 32 levels (to be supported in 2.1.5)[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: Medium
Priority: Large[/h3]
Since the bosses on the 32nd level are random, there is a problem that the level of difficulty varies greatly depending on the boss selected, or that they are unreasonable.
Therefore, we will implement a dedicated boss for the 32nd level.
We plan to make it the same multiple bosses as before.

[h2]Implement Steam achievements (to be supported in 2.1.6)[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: Medium
Priority: large[/h3]
The content may be minimal, but we intend to create a base and add to it with updates.


[h2]Implement additional extra cards (to be supported in 2.1.7)[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: Large
Priority: Large[/h3]
Tasks that are high priority but have been put on the back burner because they will affect future balancing.
Themes have been decided.

[h2]More meta cards and front-loaded (strong early game) cards[/h2]
[h3]Time: Medium
Priority: major[/h3]
With the implementation of difficulty level Very Hard, firepower in the early stages and cards for bosses have become even more important.
Therefore, we would like to add cards to the default card pool.
We will add about 4 cards for each character.
The default card pool will grow a bit, but we plan to offset this with the reroll feature.

[h2]Weaken some of Smyrna's combo parts because Smyrna's combo performance is too high. [/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: Medium
Priority: Medium[/h3]
Smyrna was implemented late in the game's production, resulting in a higher overall card power. On the other hand, it lacks the means to provide firepower in the early stages of the game.
This has hindered gameplay on the difficulty level of Very Hard, and the problem is that the battle tends to be about whether or not a combo can be established.
Our policy is to increase the number of cards needed for combos without reducing card power when used alone.

[h2]Enhanced treasure and elite rewards[[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: Large
Priority: large[/h3]
There is a problem that some of the cards in the treasure and elite rewards are not that useful and that the picks tend to be fixed because there are still few variations.
Therefore, it is desirable to increase the number of new cards and strengthen existing cards.
In particular, we would like to increase the variety of artifacts, and we would like to increase the number of abilities that affect things other than battles.


[h2]Enhanced diversity of story rewards[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: Large
Priority: small[/h3]
Details to be determined.
The rewards for finishing a story are mediocre, so we would like to make the system such that upsides occur.
For example, implement an artifact that is limited to story rewards.
Also, there is no point in recovering when you are at maximum health, so we would like to make it a selective system.


[h2]Initial artifact can be changed[/h2]
[h3]Man-hours: medium
Priority: low[/h3]
You can select an initial artifact that fits your play style from several candidates.
There is also a purpose to make it possible to release functions with experience and to create a way to use experience.

[h3]Estimated man-hours[/h3]
[list]
[*] minimum: completed in hours
[*] Small: to be completed in days
[*] Medium: to be completed in weeks
[*] Large: to be completed in months
[*] Extra-large: about six months
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Story volume increased Another person in charge is working on it.
[*] English translation being handled by another staff member
[/list]


[h1]Future product versions[/h1].
At the time of distribution, we were planning to release the production version in six months to a year.
As improvements have been brought to light, it has become clear that we will need about a year and a half to two years. We apologize to those who are waiting for the commercial version, but it will take time to add features.

For the production version (ver 3.x.x), we would like to update it with the following three points.
[olist]
[*] Implement additional features up to at least “implement additional extra cards”.
[*] Complete English language support
[*] Increase the volume of the storyline.
[/olist]

We will continue to work on fixing bugs and improving the game experience in addition to the additional features, and we look forward to working with you again this year.

<Translated by Deepl>

notes.title: ver2.1.3 Update Contents
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the ver2.1.3 update of Dungeon Artifact.
We have made some specification changes and bug fixes. We appreciate all the bug reports in the threads, as it is not feasible to fix all the bugs by debugging only by the developers. We will continue to update the software.

[h2]Specification Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The next boss can now be seen on the map screen.
[*] The volume can now be adjusted finely (100 levels). The volume can be adjusted with the left and right keys when using the buttons.
[*] On the character selection screen, the difficulty level selected by default used to be the highest difficulty level, but now it defaults to the most recently started difficulty level except when a new difficulty level is released.
[*] The ability display window now appears when selecting a card, even with keystrokes.
[*] The rarity of Shine Orbs and Life Absorbing Devices has been changed.
[*] Store prices have been revised downward across the board.
[*] The Magic Scroll ability now allows permanent cards in the hand to be placed on the field. However, you must discard two permanent cards as a cost.
[*] Cards that cannot be purchased because there are not enough magic stones in the card square are now displayed in red text.
[*] When selecting a direction when copying a card, clicking on an enemy should now respond.
[*] The layout of the automata detail screen has been slightly changed.
[*] The cancel button is now highlighted in the counter card activation confirmation.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the same behavior as pressing “yes” when trying to cancel the disenchantment “Can I destroy it?"
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the trigger ability to behave incorrectly when copying Dirac's Sea.
[*] Fixed a flagging error for three attack cards, Curse of the Fool, Blessing of the Poison Fang, and Dement. This fixed a bug that prevented Absolute Zero and others from being activated against those cards.
[*] Fixed a bug where the ability to sublimate would force a debuff regardless of position.
[*] Incorrect text for quick casts has been fixed. The behavior has not changed.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an inability to progress if an enemy was defeated while a card excluded by an enemy's ability was being returned to his hand by a power stone.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused damage limiter and Path to the Void abilities to extend to other enemies.
[/list]

<Translated with DeepL>

notes.title: ver2.1.0 Update Contents
notes.content:
We apologize for the very long wait.
We are pleased to announce the ver 2.1.0 update of Dungeon Artifacts.
The main focus of this update is the addition of a new difficulty level, Very Hard. This difficulty is characterized by the fact that enemies stand in the way with artifacts. The difficulty level has increased significantly from the past, as players are now being interfered with from many different angles.

We will be adjusting the difficulty level of Very Hard to reflect the opinions of those who have played the game, so the playing experience may change in the future as a result of updates. Please understand this. On the other hand, the difficulty levels of Normal and Hard will not change much in the future.
If you have any comments about the difficulty level, please contact us in the request thread.

Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778158/e9ab928bba79c382d29f38eebcd487915b979cd9.png[/img]

[h2]Difficulty level Very Hard added[/h2]
[list]
[*] It will be released if you have cleared the hard difficulty level.
[*] The contents of the enemy's deck are slightly different from the previous ones, so a different strategy is required.
[*] The enemies of Elite Mas Bosmas now possess artifacts. This ensures that the player's disadvantageous abilities are always at work.
[*] Boss artifacts are displayed on the screen and can be clicked on or viewed in text on the enemy detail screen.
[/list]

[h2]Changed specifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] In one level, you can now choose the option to get two random cards.
[*] Only for difficulty levels Normal and Hard, the amount of thorns in the 1-10 level elite boss helix (boss with thorns) has been changed to 2=>1.
[/list]

[h2]Card ability fixes[/h2]
Adjustments were made mainly to Lydia's cards that did not have a role or low output.
[list]
[*] [Windthrust] 8=>11 damage modified.
[*] [Windstorm Charge] 6=>10 damage modified.
[*] [Combat readiness] Modified to gain an additional +2 rage.
[*] [Night Curtain] Modified to barrier 2=>4.
[*] [Iron Wall] Eliminate restrictions on cost 5 or more.
[*] [Eye of Typhoon] Modified to Barrier 6=>9.
[*] [Revelation]　8=>14 damage modified.
[*] [Fragment Fusion]　10=>16 damage modified.
[*] [Water Cutter]　Corrected to 1=>3 squares in front.
[*] [Cabrera Stone] Modified to  that it only triggers when you gain enchantment from your ability.
[*] [Stardust] In addition to damage, the ability is also applied when health is reduced.
[*] [Parry] Modified to 0 cost 5 barrier.
[/list]

[h2]bug fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where returning to the title screen from a dungeon and opening the config would not work properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the number of draws for a black hole was 4 instead of 3.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented [Revelation]'s ability from being activated.
[/list]

notes.title: ver2.0.9 Update contents
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the ver2.0.9 update of Dungeon Artifact.
In ver2.0.9, the game seed value can now be set and some bug fixes have been made.
New difficulty level will be added in the next ver2.1.0. We will work hard on the production.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2412329411174142092/E39828AF96315C4E719127F2A0DC3CA7EC5C063B/[/img]
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2412329411174102230/A73F94E72621962AC9A4F34704D39C8677EAEBC5/[/img]

[h2]New Function[/h2]
[list]
[*] Seed value can now be specified at the start of the game.
The range that can be set is from 0 to 4,294,967,295(uint.MaxValue).
As long as you play with the same seed value, the map structure and card rewards will all be the same for different plays.
If you start a game without specifying a seed specification, the seed value will be random.
The seed value will always be displayed on the score and config screens.
If the seed value is randomly determined, it will be displayed as a random seed value.
If it is set manually, it will be displayed as a specified seed value.
Note: Seed values prior to 2.0.8 cannot be confirmed.
[*] Even if you could, you would not be able to play the same game because the specifications are different.
[/list]



[h2]Card ability changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] “Kaleidoscope”
Modified card ability from “every time I end my turn” to “every time an enemy or I end my turn” to recover MP 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the event to obtain a magic stone when clearing a scenario, where the text was garbled.
[*] Fixed a bug where the back button was sometimes invisible when selecting a character
[*] Fixed an issue where progress would become impossible when encountering a boss while in possession of the Wheel of Wisdom.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the order of application of the Blasting ability was reversed.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the draw ability of Liberation to loop infinitely
[/list]

notes.title: ver2.0.6 update contents

Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2459606329268357052/4428FFED517268670C3C2D3CA930846AC0C56DBB/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[h2]Changed specifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pressing the upper key on the gamepad or keyboard to see the card details of the hand, but it is prone to mishandling. Therefore, it has been changed so that it can be viewed by holding down the key for 0.2 seconds.
[*] The player's attack range is now shown in orange to distinguish between the enemy's attack range and the player's own attack range.
[*] Clear time is displayed on the result screen.
[*] The specification was such that the target of a "Dual cast" could not be selected that could not pay MP, so an infinite loop could occur in which only a "Dual cast" could be selected as the target of a "Dual cast". Therefore, the specification was changed so that the target of a "Dual cast" that is a copy can be selected even if it cannot pay MP.
[/list]


[h2]Card Adjustment[/h2]
Black Hole's infinite loop was determined to be X cards draw was not good, so it was adjusted to fixed 3 cards draw.
Since the infinite loop can be easily achieved when combined with “Synthsize,” we made some adjustments to increase the number of cards required for the combo by one or two.

notes.title: ver2.0.5 update contents
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the contents of the ver2.0.5 update of Dungeon Artifact.
We have added several features and fixed some bugs.

[h2]Additional Functions[/h2]
Added the ability to make the mouse invisible and disabled during controller operation in the configuration.
Changed to allow simultaneous controller and keyboard operation.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
Fixed a bug in which X was not initialized to 0 for cards that refer to the number of activations, such as Storm of Bullets, Piercing Shot, and Reincarnation.
Fixed a bug where the cost of Destroy Laser and Plasma Laser was 2 instead of 3

[h2]Card ability changes[/h2]
Catastrophe: changed to cost 3=>2, “[Permanent] All damage to you and your enemies is doubled. [Activate] You can activate this card on your turn. Send this card on the field to the Graveyard.” Changed to ability.
Water Cutter: Damage changed to 7=>10.

notes.title: ver2.0.4 update contents
notes.content:
We had informed you that the update would be 4/19, but we apologize that it is now 4/20.
The ver 2.0.4 update will add functions and fix bugs, including support for the STEAM cloud.
In addition to that, we will be making upward and downward adjustments to card abilities to account for card power differences between characters.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

[h2]機能追加[/h2]
[list]
[*] steamクラウド対応
[*] 解放したカードプールの有効化、無効化を設定する機能を追加
[*] マップ画面にも試練の進行状態を表示させるように変更
[/list]

[h2]仕様変更[/h2]
[list]
[*] 敵マスにて、階段がプレイヤーのすぐ近くに生成されるように変更
[*] スタートマスにて、ボスアーティファクトの取得を常時表示するように変更。但し、10F以上でゲームオーバーしていない限り、最大HPを-20するデメリットが付く。
[/list]

[h2]不具合修正[/h2]
[list]
[*] ボス戦のエンカウント時にターン終了ボタンを押せてしまう不具合を修正
[*] コントローラでカードリストが開けないバグを修正
[*] デュアルエレメントに廃棄がついていない不具合を修正
[*] コピーの方向選択時にカードリスト等が開いていれば方向を選択できないように修正。
[*] スキップボタンが反応しないことがある不具合を修正
[*] レインカーネーションのトリガー能力が発動した際に進行不能になる場合があるバグを修正
[*] イモータルオブジェクト、アストラルバリアの影響が敵にも及んでしまう不具合を修正
[*] レインカーネーション、ピアーシングショット、ストームオブバレッツ等の、発動したカード枚数を参照するカードについて、生成したカードの発動枚数が0にリセットされてしまう不具合を修正
[*] ウィングヘルムがエンチャントに対して発動しない不具合を修正
[*] 2回連続でストーリーマスに移動するとスキップボタンが表示されないバグを修正
[*] 明けの明星のコストが次のバトルでもコストが下がったままになる不具合を修正
[*] フロストバーンが方向指定できないバグを修正
[*] キーワード能力のクールダウンのついているカードでも生成したカードや別の同名カードを発動できてしまう不具合を修正
[*] MPコストを1にする能力とMPコストを下げる能力が重なった際の、キッカーコスト計算の不具合を修正
[*] MPやダメージ予測の値が改行されてしまう不具合を修正
[/list]


[h2]カード能力の上方修正、下方修正[/h2]
[list]
[*] タクティカルリロード:　クールダウンのデメリットを追加
[*] スーパーコンダクター:　コスト3に変更、カウントダウン3を追加
[*] サモンブレード:　3=>2コストに修正
[*] 明けの明星:　1=>2MP回復に修正、保留を追加
[*] ダブルマジック:　2=>1コストに変更
[*] オーバーロード:　2=>1コストに変更
[*] 魔法陣の解明:　すべてのカードを対象にとれるように変更
[*] バニッシュストーム:　攻撃範囲を2マス以内の最も近い敵に修正
[*] シャープエッジ:　キッカー能力に強化+1を追加
[*] ディスエンチャント:　対象がなくても発動可能に変更、堅牢+2を追加
[*] ダブルマジック:　2=>1コストに変更
[*] オーバーロード:　2=>1コストに変更
[*] パワーオブグリード:　除外タイミングをターン終了時に除外に変更
[*] アウェイキング:　MP+3増加に変更
[*] ウォーターストリーム:　強化+1を追加
[*] フォトンレイ:　強化+1を追加
[*] アシッドレイン:　5回攻撃に変更
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: ver2.0.3 update contents
notes.content:
Update was made in ver 2.0.2 due to a critical bug in the permanent card "Mapping".

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Mapping" trigger ability always being ready to trigger.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the "Clone" ability from selecting possessed cards on the stack.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented cards with multiple kickers from progressing past X=255.
[*] Fixed a bug where triggering abilities on the stack would trigger additional triggering abilities.
[/list]

We apologize to everyone who was unable to play properly due to the bug.
Thank you for your continued support of Dungeon Artifact.

notes.title: ver2.0.1アップデート内容
notes.content:
アーリーアクセス版であるにもかかわらず、多くの方にプレイしてくださっていて、とても嬉しい限りです。
ダンジョンアーティファクトのver2.0.1アップデート内容をお知らせします。
SNS・レビュー・コミュニティノートの内容を拝見し、主にカード能力・テキストの不具合修正と、優先すべきと判断した機能の実装を行いました。

[h1]追加機能[/h1]
[list]
[*] カウンターカードの発動確認がストレスであるため、スキップモードを実装しました。スキップモードがONである限り、カードの発動確認を全てスキップすることができます。
マウスの場合はスキップボタンをクリックでモードのON/OFFができます。キーボード・コントローラの場合はキャンセルボタンを押している間はスキップモードがONになります。
[*] カード能力の処理中に、敵情報の確認とカード領域の確認を行えるようになりました。
[*] カード能力の処理に時間がかかる場合があるため、コンフィグ画面から処理のアニメーション速度を「普通・速い・高速」から選択できるようにしました。
[*] 敵をクリックして情報を確認した際に、敵が次に使用するカードを確認できるようになりました。
[*] UIに敵のHPが隠れて見えなくなってしまうケースの対策として周期的にUIの上に表示させるようになりました。
[/list]

[h1]バグ・不具合修正[/h1]

[list]
[*] ドッペルゲンガーの対象が意図せず変更されてしまうバグを修正しました。
[*] マグネティックフィールドの麻痺+1の表記になっているが、実際には知力-1が付与されてしまうバグを修正しました。
[*] ヒートヘイズがフィールドにいなくても誘発するバグを修正しました。
[*] マッピングと合わせ鏡の対象が変更されてしまうバグを修正しました。
[*] 特定のカードによって敵のカード能力が解決される前に倒すと進行不能になるバグを修正しました。
[*] セレモニアルナイフの能力で再生8を得られないバグを修正しました。
[*] マナチャージのプレイ能力で正しいカードを生成できないバグを修正しました。
[/list]


[h1]カードの弱体化[/h1]

[list]
[*] 「ブラックホール」
廃棄のデメリットが追加されました。
[*]「インバーススペル」
コスト5に変更しましたが、保留の能力が削除されました。
[*] 「パワーストーン」
除外領域を対象にすると廃棄のデメリットを持つように変更されました
[*] 「ヴァジュラ」
ボス撃破時の報酬に変更されました。
[*] 「オーソリティ」
トリガー能力のコストでMP2払うことを要求するように変更しました。
[/list]


[h1]細かい修正[/h1]
[list]
[*] バリアとMPの上限のみ999999999に設定しました。
[*] 「時限爆弾」のテキスト修正
[*] 「インテグラルバーン」のテキスト修正
[*] 「リジェネレーション」のテキスト修正
[*] 「マイアスマ」のテキスト修正
[*] エンハンスドレジスタンスのアイコンに移動マークがあるのを修正
[*] マップ確認画面でストーリーマスがボスマス表記になっているのを修正
[/list]
